title: Stem-changing verbs
listenFocus: A forecast and a weekend conversation
practiceFocus: Describe today’s weather and one plan it affects

points.title: The middle vowel changes, the endings don’t
points.rule: These verbs use the same endings as day 10, but the stressed vowel in the middle shifts. Poder and dormir change o to ue. Empezar and querer change e to ie. Pedir changes e to i. Nosotros keeps the original vowel, because that syllable is not stressed.

grammar.notYet: Every stem-changing verb that exists. Learn these four and add more the same way when you meet them.

phrases.note: Weather: hace calor, hace frío, hace sol, hace viento, llueve, nieva, está nublado.

phrases.english: It rains a lot in April.
When it rains, I can’t go out.

phrases.spanish: Empiezo a trabajar a las nueve.

phrases.english: I ask for help if I need it.

phrases.spanish: No duerme bien cuando hace calor.
phrases.english: He or she doesn’t sleep well when it’s hot.

phrases.spanish: Podemos ir el sábado si no llueve.
phrases.english: We can go Saturday if it doesn’t rain.

lines.speaker: Alex
lines.spanish: Hace sol, pero dicen que llueve mañana.
lines.english: It’s sunny, but they say it will rain tomorrow.

lines.speaker: Sara
lines.spanish: Entonces, ¿podemos ir a la playa hoy?
lines.english: So, can we go to the beach today?

lines.speaker: Alex
lines.spanish: Sí. Yo empiezo a trabajar a las tres, pero antes puedo ir.
lines.english: Yes. I start work at three, but I can go before that.

lines.speaker: Sara
lines.spanish: Perfecto. Si llueve mañana, pedimos comida y dormimos hasta tarde.
lines.english: Perfect. If it rains tomorrow, we will order food and sleep in.

practice.title: Weather and a plan
practice.instruction: Say what the weather is like today. Then say one plan that depends on it, using at least two stem-changing verbs: puedo, empiezo, pido, duermo.
tips: Say the whole verb out loud, not just the infinitive.
Puedo, not poder. Empiezo, not empezar.
